## 7. Insights & takeaways

- **System is profitable in-sample so far.** +57.9 % cumulative realized across 19 closed trades, 11 / 8 win/loss, no closed loss bigger than −5.9 %. Average winner (+7.04 %) is **2.8×** the average loser (−2.55 %), which is the dominant driver of the result. Sample size is small — read this as *encouraging*, not *validated*.
- **Take-profit is doing all the winning, desk-decision is doing most of the losing.** Every win exit is a TAKE_PROFIT; only 2 of 8 losses actually hit STOP_LOSS — the rest are early discretionary exits. The desk is acting as a soft stop. This is fine but obscures whether the *original* stop placement is calibrated; the backtesting backlog item should treat DESK_DECISION exits as "would-have-been-stopped" controls.
- **DR is doing real work.** 86 % of DR runs change the PM call, and DR flips PM-BUY to AVOID 41 % of the time. Today's CAH override (BUY → AVOID with a coherent fundamental thesis on Navista impairment + opioid litigation) is a textbook DR save — exactly the failure mode DR was added for. **However, DR only ran on 35 / 253 lifetime rows (14 %)**; the funnel is leaving most BUY_LIMITs untouched (today's FLS and META included). Define the routing rule explicitly.
- **The "Owned" label and the live book have drifted apart.** 20 `decision_points` say `status='Owned'` but have no `desk_positions` row. Today alone: 4 of those (CAH, FLS, META, RRR) — and DR has already invalidated 2 of them. Anything that consumes `decision_points.status` for ownership is wrong; only `desk_positions.status='ACTIVE'` is correct. Treat the schema mismatch as the source-of-truth question to settle first.
- **Sector and `ai_score` enrichment have silently broken.** Both fields are NULL on >95 % of rows, and 100 % of today's rows. Sector NULLs make the report's clustering manual; `ai_score` NULLs mean any filter or sort using it is degenerate. These are quiet, high-blast-radius regressions.
- **`decision_tracking` is the single biggest hole.** With zero tracking rows, the 1-week recovery thesis cannot be measured. Without that signal, prompt-tuning work on PM/DR is blind; the realized-P&L view above is *the only* feedback loop the system has, and it's a noisy proxy.
- **The PENDING queue is rotting.** 17 rows >24 h old, oldest 21 days, includes APA from row id 1. None of these are ever going to come back; they should be closed out or rerun on cadence.
- **Today's flow is on baseline (~14 candidates) but unusually actionable** (4 of 14 actionable vs ~21 % long-run baseline). The two BUYs (CAH, RRR) were both knocked back by DR; net live additions today = 0 confirmed (META, FLS still in DR limbo).

## 8. Suggested next actions (prioritised)

1. **Fix `decision_tracking` writes.** Pinpoint where the tracker is supposed to fire and confirm the loop is actually running. Until this works, no improvement to the rest of the pipeline can be measured. *(blocks the backtesting harness on the backlog)*
2. **Reconcile the "Owned" / `desk_positions` mismatch.** Decide whether `decision_points.status='Owned'` is supposed to mean "PM called it" or "we actually bought it". Pick one, fix the writer to match, and add an integrity check to CI / startup.
3. **Restore `ai_score` and `sector` enrichment.** Both fields are 100 % NULL on today's runs — likely a one-line regression each. Quick wins that re-enable downstream filters and sector caps.
4. **Clear the DR backlog on today's open BUY_LIMITs (META, FLS).** DR has shown a strong override signal — running it before letting these flip Owned would prevent another CAH-style ghost. Then make the BUY_LIMIT-routing rule explicit (currently 0 of the 18 lifetime BUY_LIMIT-no-DR rows ever got a verdict).
5. **Garbage-collect the PENDING queue.** 17 stuck rows >24 h. Either rerun them on a nightly job or transition them to a terminal `CANCELLED` state. The oldest entries (APA, PBMRF, TPL) have been pending for ≥3 weeks.
6. **Re-mark CRS and SOFI.** Both ACTIVE positions opened 2026-04-29 have no `current_price`. Investigate why the quote-refresher skipped them.
7. **Watch ALLE intraday tomorrow.** It's the only ACTIVE position with single-digit headroom (3.4 %) and is sitting almost flat — a continued downside session puts it inside the stop-loss alert envelope.
8. **Add ERROR_PARSING retry.** 8.6 % failure rate on DR parses (3 lifetime). Cheap win to wrap the parse + one retry with a stricter prompt.
9. **Repair the audit destinations.** Connect both `~/Desktop/private/Stocks/Investment Decisions Claude/` and `~/Documents/Claude/Projects/Investment Ideas and Portfolio/stockdrop/` to the Cowork session that runs this scheduled task, otherwise every future run will fall back to `audit_reports/` only.
